coreSkills.title: Core Skills

01.title: TINT
01.description: A full-featured e-commerce platform for Korean cosmetics, designed and developed end-to-end.
01.subtext: Implemented complete purchase flow, role-based access (User / Manager / Admin), admin dashboard, and sales analytics. Built with React, TypeScript, Redux Toolkit, Node.js, and PostgreSQL.

02.title: WATCH
02.description: A movie and TV show discovery platform with AI-powered search and recommendations.
02.subtext: Built a prompt-based search using OpenAI, integrated TMDB and YouTube APIs, and implemented recommendation logic with metadata weighting. Developed with Next.js and TypeScript.

03.title: NoteFlow
03.description: A note-taking web application with tagging, search, and content organization features.
03.subtext: Implemented note creation and editing, tag-based filtering, full-text search, sorting, and pagination. Built with React/Next.js, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and JWT-based authentication.

04.title: Tarot App
04.description: A multilingual Tarot reading mobile app with AI-powered predictions.
04.subtext: Built a React Native/Expo app with 78 Tarot cards, integrated OpenAI GPT-4 for generating personalized readings, and implemented multi-language support (Russian, English, Korean) with i18next. Users ask questions, draw cards, and receive AI-generated mystical interpretations.
